enabled.description: Simultaneous Ring is enabled or not.

doNotRingIfOnCallEnabled.description: When set to `true`, the configured phone numbers won't ring when on a call.

phoneNumbers.description: Enter up to 10 phone numbers to ring simultaneously when a workspace phone receives an incoming call.

criteria.description: A list of criteria specifying conditions when simultaneous ring is in effect.

criteriasEnabled.description: When `true`, enables the selected schedule for simultaneous ring.

scheduleName.description: Name of the location's schedule which determines when the simultaneous ring is in effect.

source.description: If criteria are applicable for calls from any phone number or specific phone number.

ringEnabled.description: When set to `true` simultaneous ringing is enabled for calls that meet the current criteria. Criteria with `ringEnabled` set to `false` take priority.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number set as the sequential number.

answerConfirmationRequiredEnabled.description: When set to `true` the called party is required to press 1 on the keypad to receive the call.

Source.description:
* `ALL_NUMBERS` - Criteria applies to all incoming numbers.
 * `SPECIFIC_NUMBERS` - Criteria applies only for specific incoming numbers.
